elements.name: Inspect the extrusion row context menu

steps.name: an active part in the MCAD Software contains a block created by an extrusion
the extrusion row is visible in the model browser
the user right-clicks the extrusion row
the row is highlighted and the block edges are highlighted in blue
the context menu offers Edit Sketch and Edit Feature
the context menu offers Show Dimensions, Measure and Properties
the context menu offers Expand All Children and collapses All Children
the user dismisses the menu and clicks empty viewport space
the context menu and blue edge highlighting disappear
